Chat request with tool_choice set to required forces the model to call a tool

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:liter_llm/liter_llm.dart';
import 'package:liter_llm/src/liter_llm_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final request = await createChatCompletionRequestFromJson(json: '{"messages":[{"content":"What is the weather today?","role":"user"}],"model":"gpt-4","tool_choice":"required","tools":[{"function":{"description":"Get the current weather for a given location","name":"get_weather","parameters":{"properties":{"location":{"description":"The city name","type":"string"}},"required":["location"],"type":"object"}},"type":"function"}]}');
    final apiKey = Platform.environment['API_KEY'];
      if (apiKey == null || apiKey.isEmpty) { throw StateError('API_KEY must be set'); }
      final client = await LiterLlmBridge.createClient(apiKey);
    final result = await client.chat(req: request);
    stdout.writeln(result);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
